args.title: Fix password reset email link to use the correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently uses a hardcoded localhost URL. This change updates the BASE_URL to ensure that the correct public URL is used for the password reset link, preventing unresolvable links for users.
